refusal.segment.invalid: A saved change in this project is damaged, so the app stopped. Restore the project from a backup, or ask for help.
refusal.segment.misnamed: A saved change has the wrong file name, so the app stopped. Restore the project from a backup, or ask for help.
refusal.outbox.invalid: A change that was waiting to save is damaged. The app kept it. Ask for help before you continue.
refusal.segment.foreign-actor: This computer's change folder holds another computer's changes. This can happen when a project folder is copied by hand. Ask for help.
refusal.actor.record-mismatch: The project's record of this computer names a different computer. This can happen when a project folder is copied by hand. Ask for help.
refusal.ledger.unreadable: A record that this computer keeps about the project is damaged. The project files were not changed. Ask for help.
refusal.open.unexplained-divergence: Another program changed the files listed above, and the app cannot match the changes. Nothing was overwritten. Undo the outside change, or ask for help.
refusal.open.story-divergence: A story file was changed outside the app. The app cannot merge story changes. Undo the outside change, then open the project again.
refusal.story.base-missing: A story file was deleted outside the app. Your drafted text is still saved. Restore the file, for example from the trash, then open the project again.
refusal.open.not-a-project: This folder is not a translationCore project, so the app cannot open it.
refusal.open.scope-unreadable: The app could not read the project's book list. Open the project again.
refusal.seed.mismatch: The app could not read this project's files exactly, so it saved nothing. The items listed above show the problem. Ask for help.
refusal.seed.publish-failed: The first setup of this project did not finish saving. Open the project again to finish it.
refusal.checkpoint.divergence: A file changed outside the app. Your work is saved. Open the project again: the app fixes changed book files, or it names the files it cannot fix.
refusal.checkpoint.scope-mismatch: The project's book list does not match your saved work. Your work is saved. Ask for help.
refusal.checkpoint.incomplete-inputs: A file the checkpoint needs is missing. Your work is saved. Open the project again, then try again.
refusal.checkpoint.metadata-unwritable: This version of the platform cannot save a project settings change. Your work is saved in the journal and is not lost.
refusal.journal.clock-not-ratcheted: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.segment.bad-path: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.segment.differs-from-accepted: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.outbox.different-action: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.actor.name-already-set: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.checkpoint.unsafe-path: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.checkpoint.too-deep: The app stopped to protect your project. This is a problem in the app. Ask for help.
refusal.export.checkpoint-failed: The app could not save a checkpoint before the export, so it exported nothing. Your work is saved. Try the export again.
refusal.export.read-failed: The app could not make the export file, so it exported nothing. The project did not change. Try the export again.
refusal.export.print-failed: The app could not print the PDF, so it exported nothing. The project did not change. Close the app, open it again, and export the PDF again. If it fails again, choose a different export from this menu.
refusal.export.print-failed-pictures: The app could not print the PDF with its pictures, so it exported nothing. The project did not change. Close the app and open it again. Then set Pictures to off, and export the PDF again.
refusal.export.nothing-drafted: Draft at least one verse of this book, then export the PDF again.
refusal.import.write-failed: The partly written Bible was removed, so nothing was added to this computer. Your files are unchanged.
refusal.import.name-exists: A project with this name is already on this computer. Change the Bible name, then import again.
refusal.sync.own-file-differs: Door43 has a different copy of one of your saved changes. The sync stopped, and nothing changed. Ask for help.
refusal.sync.incoming-invalid: A teammate's change on Door43 is damaged. The sync stopped, and nothing changed. Ask the teammate to sync again, or ask for help.
refusal.sync.metadata-overlay: This project holds a change to the project details that a sync cannot save. The sync stopped, and nothing changed. Ask for help.
refusal.sync.obs-unsupported: Sync with Door43 works only for Bible projects. This is an Open Bible Stories project, so nothing changed.
refusal.sync.auth-failed: Door43 did not accept your sign-in. Sign in to Door43 again, then sync. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.offline: The internet is off. Turn on the internet, then sync again. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.not-shared: This project is not on Door43 yet. Share it first, then sync. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.clone-path-exists: A folder with the same name as the Door43 project is on this computer, so the sync stopped. Nothing changed. Ask for help.
refusal.sync.clone-failed: The app could not get the project from Door43. Make sure that the internet is on, then sync again. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.move-failed: The app could not get the copy from Door43 ready. Your project did not change. Sync again.
refusal.sync.verify-failed: The app found a problem in the combined project, so it did not send it to Door43. Nothing changed. Ask for help.
refusal.sync.non-fast-forward: Your teammates sent changes to Door43 during your sync. Sync again. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.no-write-access: Door43 did not let you send changes to this project. Ask the project owner for write access. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.push-failed: The app could not send your changes to Door43. Sync again. If this occurs again, ask for help. Nothing changed.
refusal.opslog.not-loaded: The app could not read its record of unfinished work. Close the app and open it again. Until then, you cannot sync a project.
refusal.sync.failed: The sync stopped because of an error. Your project did not change. Sync again. If this occurs again, ask for help.
refusal.sync.project-replaced: This project was synced, so the app must open it again. Close the project and open it again. Then make your last change again.
refusal.sync.not-main: The Door43 repository of this project does not have main as its default branch. Ask the project owner to make main the default branch on Door43. Nothing changed.
refusal.sync.apply-pending: The app is finishing a sync of this project. Wait, then open the project again. If you see this message again, sync the project again.
refusal.sync.cleanup-failed: The sync is done, and your project has the changes. The app could not remove its temporary files. Sync again to remove them.

check.explain.ready: The pinned resource is on this computer. The check list for {book} derives from it.
check.explain.fetch: This project pins a version that is not on this computer yet. The app can download it now.
check.explain.unavailable: The pinned version is not on this computer. Download it, or keep working — this does not stop anything else.
check.explain.unpinned: This project has not pinned resources for this tool yet. Get the source texts to pin them.
check.explain.not-covered: The pinned resources do not include {book}. Another gateway language, or a newer version, may cover it.
check.explain.old-twl: A pre-release version of translationCore pinned the Translation Words links of this project. The check list for {book} cannot come from that pin. Create the project again.
fix.title: {tool} needs a resource that is not on this computer
fix.subtitle: The project pins {pin} for {book}. Choose one way to get it.
fix.fetch.title: 1 · Download the pinned version
fix.fetch.body: Download {pin} from git.door43.org. The file is checked against the pinned commit before it is installed.
fix.repin.title: 2 · Use a version that is installed
fix.repin.body: Move the project's pin to one of these installed versions. The check list is derived again and every decision is carried over or kept as invalid — you confirm the counts first.
fix.repin.none: No other version of {repo} is installed on this computer.
fix.repin.confirmTitle: Re-pin the {set} to the installed version?
fix.sideload.title: 3 · Sideload it from a file
fix.sideload.body: Choose a Scripture Burrito zip of {pin}. It is installed only if it declares the pinned commit ({sha}…).
fix.sideload.drop: Drop the zip here, or browse
fix.sideload.hint: A Door43 export (.zip) of the pinned release
check.neverBlocks: A tool that is not ready never blocks the rest of your work. Drafting, other books, and the other tool carry on.
check.noItems: No items in this book yet
check.progressError: Progress could not be derived. The tool still opens.
check.bookmark.hint: Bookmark this check to come back to it
check.comment.title: My comment on this check
check.comment.placeholder: Say what you decided, or what to ask your team about this check.
check.notDraftedFrame: This frame is not drafted yet. Draft it first, then return to check.
check.origUnavailable: The original-language text is not on this computer.
check.noGateway: This project lists no gateway source text.
check.crossFrame: This project's verse numbering differs from this text's. The app cannot line them up yet.
check.selectHint: Tap the word(s) in your translation that render the highlighted quote.
check.notDrafted: This verse is not drafted yet. Draft it first, then return to check.
check.articleMissing: The pinned resources do not carry the article for this check. The check still works; the explanation is missing.
check.fallbackWarn: This project pins {repo} · {version} for the primary language, but it is not on this computer. Checking uses the English fallback. Download the pinned resource to check against it.
check.warnUpgrade: These checks were made against a different version of this resource.
check.warnSwitch: These checks were made against a different resource.
check.saveRefused: This check was not saved. The project's resource changed since this book was checked — update the resource first, then check again. Nothing was lost.
check.invalidatedNotice: {n} decision(s) no longer match the draft text and need re-review. Nothing was discarded.
check.empty.none.title: No checks for this book
check.empty.none.body: The pinned resource covers this book but lists no checks in it. Nothing is wrong — there is simply nothing here to decide.
check.empty.all-dropped.title: No checks line up with this project's numbering
check.empty.all-dropped.body: The pinned resource lists checks for this book, but none of them could be placed in this project's versification numbering. The count below says how many. Nothing was lost.
check.empty.missing.title: This book is not in the pinned resource
check.empty.missing.body: The catalogue lists this book for the resource, but the pinned version does not carry a file for it. A newer version, or another gateway language, may include it.
check.empty.versification-unavailable.bo: This project uses a versification other than the default, and the numbering data needed to line the checks up could not be loaded. Nothing is lost. Open the book again, and the checks will appear.
check.empty.versification-unknown.title: Versification could not be identified
check.empty.versification-unknown.body: This project's versification scheme is not recorded and could not be matched to a known one, so the checks cannot be lined up with its numbering. This usually means the project was created elsewhere. Nothing is lost — recording the scheme, or re-creating the project in tC4, restores checking.
inspector.title: Inspector (dev)
inspector.settingsUnreadable: The ops log did not load at this start, so the app started a new one. The old bytes are kept in the settings under unreadableSettings: {error}
upgrade.title: Pinned resources
upgrade.stale: this offer is out of date — the project's pins changed. Check for updates again.
upgrade.harmless: Nothing you have already checked will be affected.
upgrade.headline: {n} decision(s) were made against the release you are leaving.
upgrade.detail: Decisions that match a check in the new release carry over. The rest stop applying, so those checks come back as work — a book that was finished will not be finished any more. Nothing is deleted.
upgrade.textsCurrent: ✓ Every scripture text is up to date
upgrade.textInvalidates: The alignments of {n} verse(s) will be marked invalid.
upgrade.textInvalidatesDetail: A new release of the original text can change the words of a verse. Each of these alignments must be checked again. Every alignment is kept. Nothing is deleted.
upgrade.textGateway: No alignment and no check decision will change. The source pane will show the new text.
upgrade.alignUnsaved: an alignment edit is not saved. Save it, then try again.
upgrade.alignReloadFailed: The pin moved and the alignments are marked invalid, but the aligner could not reload {books}. Close the project and open it again before you edit those alignments.
gateway.title: Change checking language to {lang}?
align.modeGwHint: Align to the gateway text you can read — its words already carry the original-language alignment.
align.modeOrigHint: Align directly to the original-language words.
align.modeGwUnavailable: The gateway lens needs the gateway source text with alignment data for this verse.
align.howBody: Connect each word of your translation to the word it renders. Click a word in the bank, then click its card — or drag it. Drag one card onto another to align a phrase; SPLIT undoes it. Every other check uses these links to find your words.
align.mergeHint: Drag onto another word card to merge them into a phrase
align.subHint: Original-language words this gateway word is aligned to
align.bankEmpty: Every word is placed. Click a placed word to send it back.
align.hintIdle: Click a word, then click the card it belongs under.
align.hintArmed: Now click the card this word belongs under.
align.stale: The draft changed since this alignment was made. Check that the words still line up.
align.markValidHint: This verse's alignment is done, even if some words stay unplaced. Any later change takes it back.
align.markValidRefused: Confirm or reject the suggested links first.
align.suggest.title: Suggestions
align.suggest.off: Off. Turn on to get links proposed from the verses you have already aligned.
align.suggest.none: No aligned verses yet in this testament — align a verse by hand first.
align.suggest.memory: Drawn from {n} verses you have aligned — suggestions improve as you align more.
align.suggest.memory.one: Drawn from 1 verse you have aligned — suggestions improve as you align more.
align.suggest.ready: Drawn from {n} verses you have already aligned
align.suggest.nothing: Nothing to suggest for the words still in the bank.
align.unavailable.undrafted.title: Nothing to align yet
align.unavailable.undrafted.body: Draft a verse in {book} first — alignment links your words to the original.
align.unavailable.unpinned.title: No original-language text pinned
align.unavailable.unpinned.body: This project has not pinned an original-language text, so there is nothing to align against.
align.unavailable.missing.title: The original-language text is not on this computer
align.unavailable.missing.body: Get the source texts to download it, then come back to {book}.
align.unavailable.versification-unavaila: This project uses a versification other than the default, and the numbering data needed to find the source verse could not be loaded. Nothing is lost. Open {book} again.
align.unavailable.no-counterpart.title: This verse has no single source verse
align.unavailable.no-counterpart.body: In this project's numbering, this verse does not line up with exactly one verse in the original-language text, so it cannot be aligned. The source text is installed — nothing is missing. The rest of {book} aligns normally.
This project's versification scheme is not recorded and could not be matched to a known one, so the source verse for {book} cannot be looked up safely. Nothing is lost — recording the scheme, or re-creating the project in tC4, restores alignment.
align.cardBody: Link your words to the original language. Alignment powers the highlights that show which words a check is about.
sources.checkInPrompt: This suite is installed. Check this project against {lang}?
gateway.otherProject: Another project is open now. Open this project and choose the language again.
gateway.blocked: This change cannot be applied: {books} already carry checking decisions, and the new language does not cover them. Install a suite that covers these books first. Nothing was changed.
gateway.blocked-versification-unavailabl: This change cannot be applied right now: {books} carry checking decisions, and the numbering data needed to carry them over could not be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
gateway.blocked-versification-unknown: This change cannot be applied: {books} carry checking decisions, and this project's versification scheme could not be identified, so they cannot be carried over safely. Nothing was changed. Recording the scheme, or re-creating the project in tC4, unblocks the change.
gateway.blockedError: Blocked: {books} would lose their checking resource. Nothing was changed.
check.droppedNote: {count} check(s) from this resource have no verse in this project's {scheme} numbering, so they are not shown and not counted. Nothing was lost — they return if the project's numbering ever matches the resource.
cc.title: Community Checking
cc.cardDesc: Read the book as a whole and share it with the community for feedback. Export a copy for reviewers.
cc.exportInterrupted: {filename} did not finish downloading. Export it again.
cc.exportSkipped: Your alignment of these verses is not in the file. Check them in Align: {refs}

conflicts.otherKept: Another version of this verse is kept.

net.ask.sync: get the changes of your teammates from Door43 and send the changes of this project to Door43. If necessary, tC4 signs in to Door43 first.
syncResult.restoredOne: Door43 did not have 1 change from a teammate. tC4 sent it again.
syncResult.restoredMany: Door43 did not have {n} changes from teammates. tC4 sent them again.
syncResult.missingPinsOne: This project now uses 1 resource version that is not on this computer.
syncResult.missingPinsMany: This project now uses {n} resource versions that are not on this computer.
syncResult.error.ownFileDiffers: Door43 has a different copy of one of your changes. Nothing changed. Ask for help.
syncResult.error.incomingInvalid: A file from Door43 is not valid. Nothing changed. Ask for help.
syncResult.error.metadataOverlay: This project has a change to its details that a sync cannot send. Nothing changed. Ask for help.
syncResult.error.obsUnsupported: Sync is only for Bible projects.
syncResult.error.authFailed: Sign in to Door43, then sync again.
syncResult.error.offline: The internet is off. Turn it on, then sync again.
syncResult.error.notShared: This project is not on Door43. Share it first.
syncResult.error.clonePathExists: A folder on this computer has the name of the Door43 project, so tC4 cannot get the project. Nothing changed. Ask for help.
syncResult.error.cloneFailed: tC4 could not get the project from Door43. Nothing changed. Try again.
syncResult.error.verifyFailed: The synced copy did not pass its check. Nothing was sent to Door43. Ask for help.
syncResult.error.nonFastForward: Teammates sent changes to Door43 during the sync. Sync again.
syncResult.error.noWriteAccess: Ask the project owner for write access on Door43.
syncResult.error.pushFailed: Door43 did not accept the changes. The project on this computer did not change. Try again.
syncResult.error.opsLogNotLoaded: tC4 could not read its operations record at start. Close tC4 and start it again, then sync.
shareDialog.teamAccess: Teammates need write access on Door43 to sync. The project owner gives it on Door43.
addProject.door43Desc: Work on a Bible your team shares on Door43. Every teammate opens the same project.
net.ask.open: get a full copy of the project from Door43 and check its files. Nothing from your projects is sent.
openDoor43.title: Open a project from Door43
openDoor43.subtitle: Get a full copy of a project your team shares on Door43.
openDoor43.where: The project opens from {host}. Only public repositories can be opened.
openDoor43.repoHint: Type owner/repository, or paste the link to the repository.
openDoor43.repoBad: Type owner/repository, or a link to a repository on {host}.
openDoor43.name: Project name
openDoor43.nameHint: The repository name is the default. Each project on this computer needs its own name.
openDoor43.nameBad: Use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only. Do not use spaces.
openDoor43.nameInUse: A project named “{name}” is already on this computer. Choose another name.
openDoor43.checks: tC4 checks every file before it adds the project to this computer. After the project opens, use {sync} to get your team’s work and send yours.
openDoor43.refused.invalid: One or more journal files on Door43 are not valid, so tC4 stopped. No project was added to this computer.
openDoor43.refused.obs: This is an Open Bible Stories project. Only Bible projects can be opened from Door43. No project was added to this computer.
openDoor43.refused.other: tC4 could not get the project from Door43. Make sure that the repository is public and that its name is correct. No project was added to this computer.
refusal.open-door43.name-exists: A project with this name is already on this computer. Choose another name. Nothing was written.
openDoor43.refused.noJournal: This repository is not a tC4 project: it has no tC4 journal. To bring in its files, use Import a project. No project was added to this computer.
refusal.open-door43.no-journal: This repository is not a tC4 project, so it was not opened. Use Import a project for its files. No project was added.
openDoor43.refused.clonePathExists: A folder with the same name as this Door43 repository is already on this computer, so tC4 stopped. Ask for help. No project was added to this computer.
openDoor43.refused.opsNotLoaded: tC4 could not read its record of unfinished work. Close tC4 and open it again, then try again. No project was added to this computer.
openDoor43.refused.offline: The internet is off. Turn on the internet, then try again. No project was added to this computer.
openDoor43.refused.moveFailed: tC4 could not put the project in its place on this computer. Try again. If this occurs again, ask for help. No project was added to this computer.
refusal.open-door43.pending: The app is opening this project from Door43, or it cannot prove that this project is a whole copy. The app did not open it and did not change it. Wait, then try again. If this message comes again, ask for help.
refusal.open-door43.removed: This project did not finish opening from Door43, so the app removed the part copy. Open the project from Door43 again.
